account.confirmedBody: Open Coach Poulpy on the phone you signed up with: it signs you in and sends your training.
account.confirmedPoulpy: Lifting your training into the cloud. Eight tentacles, no waiting.
account.confirmExpiredBody: It may have been used already, or it expired after 24 hours. Sign up again in the app with the same address and we’ll send a new one.
account.resetExpiredBody: It may have been used already, or it expired after an hour. In the app, tap “Forgot your password?” to get a new one.
account.resetIntro: Every phone signed in to this account will be signed out.
account.savedBody: Every phone was signed out. Open Coach Poulpy and sign in with your new password.
account.errorOffline: Coach Poulpy can’t be reached. Check your connection and try again.

admin.signInIntro: The admin is for the people who look after Coach Poulpy.
admin.errorSignIn: Wrong email or password, or this account isn’t an admin’s.
admin.errorTooMany: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
admin.errorOffline: Coach Poulpy can’t be reached. Check your connection and try again.
admin.auditIntro: Everything an admin changed, newest first. Only admins see this.
admin.auditEmpty: Nothing yet. Admin changes show up here.
admin.auditError: The audit log can’t be loaded. Try again.
admin.accountsIntro: Every account, with its state and never its workouts or health data. Open one to disable or delete it.
admin.accountsNoneHint: Change or clear the filters to see more accounts.
admin.accountsError: The account can’t be loaded. Try again.
admin.disableHint: Disabling signs this account out everywhere and blocks sign-in until you enable it again. Nothing is deleted.
admin.ownAccount: This is your own account. You can’t disable or delete it here.
admin.deleteBody: This removes {email} and everything saved for it, for good. It is the same deletion the user can ask for in the app. It cannot be undone.
admin.settingsIntro: Changes take effect on the next email. Every change is written to the audit log.
admin.settingsError: The settings can’t be loaded. Try again.
admin.mailFromHint: The address emails come from, such as Coach Poulpy <hello@example.com>.
admin.mailFromInvalid: This is not an email address. Use the form name@example.com.
admin.mailFromSaved: Saved. The next email comes from this address.
admin.saveError: The address can’t be saved. Try again.
admin.testEmailHint: Sends a message to {email} with the saved settings.
admin.testEmailFailed: The test email was not sent. The mail server said: {error}
admin.mailServerNote: The mail server (host, port, user and password) is set on the server and is not editable here.
admin.statusIntro: What the server can do right now. Only admins see this.
admin.statusError: The status can’t be loaded. Try again.
admin.mailConfiguredBody: The server sends emails through its mail server.
admin.mailMissing: No mail server is set on the server, so no email can be sent. Sign-up cannot send its confirmation link.
admin.mailMissingNote: The mail server is set with environment variables on the server, not here.
admin.lastSendNone: No email sent since the server started.
admin.pendingIntro: Accounts that have not confirmed their email yet. No email is sent from here.
admin.pendingNone: No account is waiting for its confirmation.
admin.pendingError: The pending registrations can’t be loaded. Try again.
admin.catalogIntro: The exercises every phone gets. Edit the catalog, then publish the changes.
admin.catalogSearchLabel: Search exercises by name, slug or alias
admin.catalogSelectPage: Select all exercises on this page
admin.catalogNoneHint: Try another search or clear the filters.
admin.catalogError: The catalog couldn’t be loaded. Try again in a moment.
admin.exerciseSaveFailed: The draft couldn’t be saved. Try again in a moment.
admin.exerciseSlugTaken: Another exercise already has this slug. Pick another one.
admin.exerciseMissing: This exercise isn’t in the catalog
admin.exerciseMissingHint: It may have another slug. Go back to the list to find it.
admin.exerciseLoadFailed: The exercise couldn’t be loaded. Try again in a moment.
admin.slugHint: Lowercase words joined by dashes. Editable until the exercise is first published, then never. Not translated.
admin.slugLocked: Permanent identifier used by existing workouts. Not translated.
admin.stepsHint: In order, one instruction each. Adding or removing a step does it in every language.
admin.aliasesHint: Other names people search with, separated by commas. Never shown.
admin.exerciseSlugTakenNote: Not saved. Fix the slug and save again.
admin.exerciseEditingLanguage: Editing the {language} text. English is the original; structure, variations, muscles, equipment and classification are the same in every language.
admin.musclesHint: Tap an area to add or remove its muscle group.
admin.publishIntro: Review the changes before publishing. Phones download the updated catalog the next time they open the app, guests included.
admin.publishNote: Only changed fields are listed. Publishing makes these changes available to everyone on their next app open.
admin.publishBlocked: Add the missing translations first: publishing is refused while a text lacks a language.
admin.publishFailed: The changes couldn’t be published. Try again.
admin.retireIntro: These exercises stay available until you publish the changes. Existing workouts keep working and retain their history.
admin.retireNote: Retirement removes an exercise from the catalog and exercise builder after publication. It does not delete exercise data or workout history. You can offer it again later.
admin.retireFailed: Some exercises couldn’t be retired. Try again.
admin.statusUpToDate: Nothing is awaiting publication: phones have every exercise as it stands.
admin.statusPending: Review them, then publish: phones download them the next time they open the app.
admin.dangerRetireText: Prepares a lifecycle change. The exercise remains active until a publication includes its retirement. Workouts that use it still open; nothing is deleted, and you can offer it again later.
admin.dangerDeleteText: Removes the exercise from the catalog for good, with all its translations.
admin.dangerDeletePublished: It is published: phones that already downloaded it keep it, but workouts that use it lose it. Retire it instead unless this is a test exercise.
admin.exerciseRetireIntro: {name} stays active in the published catalog until you publish this change. Existing workouts keep working and retain their history. You can cancel this pending action before publication or offer the exercise again after retirement.
admin.exerciseDeleteIntro: This removes the exercise and its translations from the catalog for good. It cannot be undone.
admin.exerciseDeletePublishedWarning: {slug} is published. Workouts that use it will lose it.
admin.exerciseDeleteFailed: The exercise couldn’t be deleted. Try again.

app.passwordBody: We email you a link to choose a new password. Every device you are signed in on is signed out when you use it.
app.resetLinkSent: If the address belongs to an account, a link is on its way.
app.dataBody: Your workouts, sessions and body log live on your phone and follow your account. To change them, open the app.
app.workoutsIntro: The workouts on your phone, as they were last synced.
app.workoutsNoneHint: Make one in the app and it shows up here once it syncs.
app.workoutsNoMatchHint: Try another word or another format.
app.workoutsError: The workouts could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
app.changeOnPhoneBody: Workouts are read-only here. Open the app to edit, plan or start this one.
app.workoutMissing: This workout isn’t on your account
app.workoutMissingHint: It may have been deleted on your phone.

status.title: Status
status.downBody: We are on it. Try again in a few minutes.
